name: Debashish Deb
title: Chief Executive Officer | Full-Stack Software Developer & Biotechnologist
tagline: CEO of Infinite IT & IT Specialist at Färkkilä Lab, University of Helsinki. Architecting scalable software and scientific digital infrastructure.
about: I am the Chief Executive Officer at Infinite IT and an IT & Systems Specialist at Färkkilä Laboratory (University of Helsinki). With an M.Sc. in Molecular Biotechnology and deep software engineering expertise, I bridge executive leadership, full-stack software development, and biomedical research computing.
aboutExtended:
As Chief Executive Officer of Infinite IT, I lead company strategy, technical product delivery, and global enterprise software partnerships spanning web, mobile, and workflow automation. Simultaneously, at the University of Helsinki's renowned Färkkilä Laboratory (Biomedicum Helsinki), I coordinate CSC scientific supercomputing services, lab web architecture, and research databases for precision oncology and spatial multi-omics.

My background in molecular biotechnology, combined with over a decade of operational excellence in Finland and co-authored cancer oncology publications in Haematologica and Blood, drives my commitment to delivering software with scientific rigor, high availability, and flawless execution.

currentRoles.summary: Directing corporate vision, offshore engineering operations, and delivery of custom Next.js, Flutter, and AI products for Western and South Asian enterprises.
Coordinating CSC Finnish IT Center for Science services, lab digital platforms, high-throughput spatial biology databases, and research infrastructure.

projects.name: Infinite IT Digital Ecosystem & Workspace
projects.description: Executive architecture and product engineering for Infinite IT's corporate platforms, client workspace systems, and offshore engineering operations. Delivers high-performance Next.js web applications, scalable cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted workflow automation.
highlights: Architected scalable offshore delivery model for North American and European enterprise clients
Automated continuous integration and zero-downtime deployment workflows
Built modular UI component library and secure client workspace dashboards

projects.name: InfiniteScan
projects.description: Privacy-first Android utility app engineered in Flutter. Features on-device ML Kit barcode & QR code recognition, zero-account architecture, bilingual Bangla/English interface, Tesseract OCR document extraction, and local SQLite history with zero third-party tracking.
highlights: 100% on-device ML inference with zero telemetry or network data leakage
Sub-100ms real-time barcode scanning with auto-focus and low-light flashlight toggle
Bilingual localization (Bangla & English) and offline SQLite scan history export

projects.name: BDNewsReader
projects.description: Bilingual news aggregation and reader platform built with Flutter, Riverpod, and a self-hosted Fastify backend. Features native article formatting, offline caching via Drift/SQLite, official YouTube Live TV streaming (IFrame integration), and bilingual Bangla/English text-to-speech audio narration.
highlights: Self-hosted Fastify backend scraping and caching verified news streams
Bilingual text-to-speech audio engine for automated article playback
Offline-first Drift ORM persistence with background periodic syncing

projects.name: Färkkilä Lab Infrastructure & Systems
projects.description: Coordinating Finnish CSC scientific computing services, relational research databases, and public web platforms for precision oncology and spatial multi-omics at Biomedicum Helsinki.
highlights: High-performance computing coordination for spatial multi-omics pipelines
Clinical registry and patient specimen tracking database architecture
Web platform development and high-availability scientific data portals

projects.name: Stations-Pathfinder
projects.description: Graph routing engine written in Golang that calculates optimal collision-free paths for concurrent trains moving across dynamic railway track topologies with turn-based orchestration.
highlights: Concurrent turn-based simulation with dynamic collision avoidance
Algorithmic graph traversal finding Pareto-optimal transit solutions
Strict Go memory constraints and high-throughput benchmark tests

projects.name: Art-Interface
projects.description: Interactive web application and decoding engine in Golang enabling users to transform, parse, and render ASCII art through an intuitive browser interface.
highlights: Custom ASCII font parser and rasterizer written in Go standard library
Real-time client-side preview with responsive export options
Zero-dependency lightweight binary deployment

projects.name: Personal Portfolio & Showcase
projects.description: Linear-grade modern portfolio with dark/light theming, seamless interactive views, responsive glassmorphism UI, command palette, and built-in interactive resume generation.
highlights: 100/100 Lighthouse performance with zero external runtime bundle
Dynamic theme switching with automatic system preference detection
Command palette (Cmd+K) and interactive filtered views
